name: How do I choose the right contractor for my house addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my house addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating several key factors. Look for licensed and insured professionals with a strong portfolio of similar projects and positive client references. Verify their experience, particularly with local building codes. Transparency in communication, detailed proposals, and a clear understanding of your vision are crucial. It's also important to ensure their work style aligns with your expectations for the project. Cali View Builders encourages potential clients to review our past work and speak with previous clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with relevant experience, strong references, clear communication, and a detailed proposal, ensuring they understand your vision.
